Studied: Combat Tactics.name: Studied: Combat Tactics
Studied: Combat Tactics.description:
♟️ You studied fighting as a problem: a team's game plans, military history, strategy games or a coach who drilled you to read opponents.

🌱 Positioning, terrain, cover, tempo and spotting a tell. In a fight you look first for the exit, the high ground and what the opponent wants.
⚠️ Unfamiliar Quirks, many fighters or a surprise attack can wreck a plan, and knowing the right move does not give you the body to make it.
⚖️ A plan for a fight is no permission to start one.
🏫 It shows in questions about the ground, the timing and the other side before anything else.

📈 Grants: Combat Tactics +15
Studied: Combat Tactics.traitNarrativeEffects: The character has studied how fights are won: positioning, terrain, cover, tempo, baiting an attack, spotting a tell and planning an engagement before it starts. In a fight they look first for the exit, the high ground and what the opponent wants. Prior study, not mastery: unfamiliar Quirks, many fighters at once and a surprise attack can still wreck a plan, and knowing the right move does not give the body to make it. Not a license: a plan for a fight is no permission to start one. It shows in questions about the ground, the timing and the other side before anything else.
